Finding 2026-08-03 during .7 Task 6 planning: the real SaveManagerCheckpointPort.prepare requires a full snapshot bundle (CHECKPOINT_INPUT_KEYS): snapshot_input WITH a lifecycle object (hence ending_plan/gameplay), plus dialogic_checkpoint, route_id, active_app_id, audio_context, content_version. But GameStateDayResolutionPort.prepare_completion emits a STUB snapshot_input = {run_id, day} only (class header: real production arrives with the Plan04 integration tasks). The real checkpoint port rejects the stub with invalid_checkpoint_inputs. Coordinator tests pass only because they use FakeCheckpointPort, which does not validate input shape.

Consequence: NO path persists a real ENDING or any snapshot to disk today. Direct scene path records no stable checkpoint (autosave returns no_stable_checkpoint, ignored); coordinator path cannot feed the real checkpoint port.

Work: make GameStateDayResolutionPort produce the full CHECKPOINT_INPUT_KEYS bundle from live GameState capture (GameState has prepare_new_run_snapshot_input for NEW runs; needs a live-run equivalent), then verify coordinator + real SaveManagerCheckpointPort + SaveManager write a real autosave that round-trips.

Dependency: dialogic_checkpoint is sourced from Dialogic which is a .8 deliverable. So this is a .8-era foundation affecting ALL day-resolution checkpoints, not just endings. Do not fold into an ending ticket.

Acceptance: driving the real coordinator days 1-7 with the real checkpoint port writes a disk autosave whose snapshot round-trips through restore; for day 7 the ending_plan survives and the restored run re-walks to COMPLETED. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-03-phase-2r-07-ending-boundary-disk-durability-design.md Blocked section.
acceptance_criteria: Driving the real coordinator through Days 1-7 with the real checkpoint port writes valid disk autosaves; the Day-7 autosave restores through configured production participants to day 7 in ENDING with the exact ending_plan, and the restored run re-walks idempotently to COMPLETED with Gallery recorded. Lifecycle/schema validators agree on the exact stage-aware post-increment source-day rule, saved checkpoints contain the completed causal stage, sequential day plans can advance, and production provider wiring is exercised.
notes: Audit 2026-08-10: focused current-worktree tests are GREEN, but acceptance is not yet proven and this issue must remain open/uncommitted. The integration only drives Day 1; its restore assertion accepts {ok:false}, configures no restore participants, commits no restore, and never re-walks a Day-7 ending to COMPLETED. RunSnapshotSchema permits a post-increment source_day/day gap while RunLifecycle still rejects it; the validator rule must be unified and stage-aware. The written checkpoint is also captured before stage completion, and completed day plans currently cannot be replaced for sequential Days 2-7. Add RED coverage for these gaps, actual Days 1-7 + Day-7 ending disk restore, production provider wiring, and the exact restored plan before commit/close.
close_reason: Real snapshot production lands: full CHECKPOINT_INPUT_KEYS bundle accepted by the real SaveManagerCheckpointPort, checkpoints carry post-completion lifecycle, Days 1-7 walk and Day-7 crash restore proven on disk.

title: Choose narrative localization adapter after representative files exist
description:
## Rationale

Only English Dialogic timelines physically exist, while the user will supply already-localized narrative files later. Choosing an adapter before one representative source/translation set exists would assume an unknown physical format and could damage stable IDs, branches, or Dialogic round trips. Affected requirement: req.locale.narrative_deferred. This decision blocks translated narrative import only; it does not block Phase 2R UI localization or English narrative validation.

## Alternatives Considered

- Godot TranslationServer resources: rejected because the approved architecture uses the user's own localized files and custom JSON for UI localization.
- Preselect a duplicated-Dialogic-timeline adapter now: rejected until physical translated files prove their structure and stable-ID behavior.
- Test at least two adapters against representative files, then record the evidence-backed choice: selected decision process.

## Decision Trigger

Reopen active work when one representative English source and corresponding external localized files are present. Inspect their formats, stable IDs, branches, and round-trip requirements before proposing the adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Representative source and translated files are present; at least two viable adapters are tested against them; the chosen adapter preserves stable IDs, branches, and Dialogic structure without inventing prose; the decision packet records evidence and closes this issue.
